items.title: Esri User Conference 2025
items.details: Worked as a student assistant alongside 60 other students from across the US for an entire week with the Esri team to help organize the largest GIS conference, with 20,000+ participants.

items.title: Forum on AI and Data Science for Agriculture
items.details: Presented a poster titled ‘LULC change of South Asia using the Random Forest Machine Learning Technique’ on April 21, 2025 at the AU Hotel.

items.title: AAG 2025
items.details: Presented on Heat Vulnerability Index and Climate Policies on Chattogram City at the American Association of Geographers (AAG) 2025 annual meeting in Detroit.

items.title: AGU 2024
items.details: Presented on Urban Heat Island, LULC Change and Heat Action Plans of South Asia at the American Geophysical Union (AGU) annual conference in DC.

items.title: AGS 2024
items.details: Presented a lightning talk on Climate Policies and Social Justice of South Asia at Columbia Climate School in New York City in November 2024.

items.title: BCCC 2022
items.details: The team presented on the energy demand-based GHG mitigation of Jahangirnagar University at the Bangabandhu Chair Closing Ceremony in Thailand, invited by Prof. Joyashree Roy.

items.title: UNLEASH 2022
items.details: Attended as a Global Talent participant at UNLEASH with 1000 other participants to find solutions related to the SDGs. The team worked on waste management (SDG 13 - Climate Action).

items.title: DRSD 2021
items.details: Presented on Post-disaster Recovery of Bangladesh at the Disaster Resilience and Sustainable Development Symposium at the Asian Institute of Technology, Thailand.

items.title: Asian Summer School 2018
items.details: Attended the summer school on Geoinformatics for Sustainable Agriculture organized by RSGIS FoS at the Asian Institute of Technology, Thailand, with participants from 9 Asian countries.
